sup:70410.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

reply.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

As we have not received a response to our final offer, we are withdrawing our proposal. We consider this negotiation closed.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

thank you for your offer regarding ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation.

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
We acknowledge receipt of your message.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €33.80 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.
Please note:
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We have incorporated your requested volume of 23,400 pieces and the 24-month contract duration into our revised proposal.
We must maintain a lead time of 54 days, as the expedited schedules you proposed carry substantial premiums.
As a matter of corporate policy, we do not disclose internal cost breakdowns.
Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 54 days: €31.90 per unit.
Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.
These are our standard conditions for this product.
We will process your next message according to our standard procedure.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
